name: Blythe
source:
Born to serve, Blythe wants nothing more than to give Bunnie their best-ever birthday. Kind, caring, and eager to please, as well as anxious and overly excitable, Blythe's only reason for existence is to bring a little happiness into Bunnie's life... at any cost!

[From [url=https://melancholy-marionette.itch.io/bittersweetblythe]Itch.io[/url]]
